prayerExcerpt.en-US: Putting nothing before Christ and always ardent in the service of your Church.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nada antepondo a Cristo e sempre empenhados no serviço da vossa Igreja.

meta.face: A lean, ascetic man of about sixty-four with a long face and a craggy, prominent brow ridge — a high, furrowed forehead, deep-set, burning dark eyes looking upward, a long, strong nose with a slight hook, sharp cheekbones over sunken cheeks, thin, tight lips; short, thick, wiry grey hair; a long, narrow, grey beard falling to the breast in wavy, tapering strands, with a full grey moustache; an intense, searching upward gaze.
meta.basis: The marble bust on Wikipedia gives him a long, tapering beard, deep-set eyes raised upward and a lean face; the Catholic tradition shows him as a cardinal with a knotted cord (the discipline). The white habit is that of the Camaldolese hermits at Fonte Avellana, where he was prior.
